issues.concern: The gloss combines two distinct meanings of the word (kind/gentle and easy) which are typically written with different kanji (優しい and 易しい respectively) and are not homographs in the sense of sharing a single underlying meaning. This can mislead learners into thinking 'easy' is a direct synonym or a related sense of 'kind/gentle' for the same kanji, when it's a separate word with a different kanji.
issues.suggestion: Separate the gloss into two distinct entries or clearly indicate the kanji difference for each meaning in the main gloss, or remove 'easy' from the main gloss as it refers to a different kanji.
